description: Multi-agent pipeline eval (Phase 4, extended in Phase 5). Every expected figure was verified against the indexed filing text. Each question costs ~7-20k Groq tokens (+~1-3k for the critic).

questions.question: By what percentage did Reliance's consolidated revenue from operations grow from 2023-24 to 2024-25?
